title: Killing of Caltech astronomer Carl Grillmair
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Killing of Caltech astronomer Carl Grillmair, about 2026 at Llano, Antelope Valley, California, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: On February 16th, 2026, about 30 mi northeast of Waterman Mountain, where Monica Resza disappeared, another colleague from Caltech and JPL would meet an equally tragic and suspicious end.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, in an episode about American scientists going missing, tells of the death of Carl Grillmair, an astronomer linked to Caltech, a university in California, and JPL, NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory. Michels says that on February 16, 2026, in Llano in California's Antelope Valley, about 30 miles from Waterman Mountain, where another Caltech and JPL colleague named Monica Resza had disappeared, Grillmair met what he calls an equally tragic and suspicious end. He tells it as part of a possible pattern of harm coming to scientists from the same circles.
